title: TMP Design Practical Sign-off
description: Submit a TMP you have designed (NZGTTM TMP Planning, General and TMD forms) for assessment by a Sela assessor against published criteria covering risk and controls, design speed, sign and exclusion-zone dimensions, tapers and delineation, and the TMD itself. Written feedback on every criterion; up to 3 attempts. Recommended first: NZGTTM-RA-01.
